title: Fig and the Storm
checkpoint: Reception Summer 1, week 4 — Phase 4: Two-syllable words: longer words with two syllables (no new sounds)
note_for_grown_ups: Phase 4 continues (Learning), 70-sound stage (st, sw, tr just added).

pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar resting on a puddle-dotted garden path under a grey sky.
Dark clouds rolling in quickly over the garden path.
Fig the caterpillar hurrying off the open path towards shelter.

pages.text: Fig creeps to a snug spot.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar making his way under the edge of a wide leaf.

pages.text: Fig sits still in the spot.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar sitting motionless, tucked safely under the wide leaf.
Heavy raindrops splashing on the garden path outside the sheltering leaf.

pages.text: Fig is snug in the spot.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar warm and dry under the leaf as rain falls around him.
The rain easing off, sunlight starting to break through the clouds.

pages.text: Fig creeps on, glad and snug.
pages.illustration: Fig the caterpillar setting off again along the now-dry path, looking content.
